info.name: RideGuard Manual SOS
info.description: Local-only regression collection. Requires an isolated backend with fake SMS and persistence dependencies, owned alertId and unlinkedAlertId fixtures, a foreignAlertId, and test users represented by firebaseIdToken, foreignToken, and noContactsToken. Default sosTestMode blocks every request. Never point it at a live SMS sender. Acceptance is not delivery. No retries. See docs/v1-sos-routes.md.

exec: if (pm.variables.get('sosTestMode') !== 'stubbed') { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Use an isolated local backend with a fake SMS sender; set sosTestMode=stubbed only for that backend.' ); }
if (!/^http:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?\/v1$/.test(pm.variables.get('baseUrl'))) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('SOS collection is restricted to a loopback /v1 target.' ); }

pm.test('standard response envelope', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(pm.response.code < 400); pm.expect(b.message).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.timestamp).to.be.a('string'); });

response.name: Owned alert has no linked SOS

exec: pm.test('standard response envelope', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(pm.response.code < 400); pm.expect(b.message).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.timestamp).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('public SOS shape', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.sosId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.requestId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('alertId'); pm.expect(d).not.to.have.property('uid'); pm.expect(d).not.to.have.property('requesterName'); pm.expect(d.recipients).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; for (const r of d.recipients) { pm.expect(r.phone).to.include('*'); pm.expect(r).not.to.have.property('providerMessageId'); pm.expect(['queued','sending','accepted','failed','unknown','cancelled']).to.include(r.initial.status); } });
